labels: Put your hand on the book!
Put Priam's hand on the book!

nodes.text: $NAMEOFFAMILIAR yelps excitedly and takes to the air!
A few seconds later, she flies back, carrying the winged stick in her jaws!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Booyah! Look at that! I did it!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...'Booyah'?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Shut up, Simon.

For the next twenty minutes, you and Simon take turns sending your familiars zipping all around campus. By the end of the training exercise, controlling $NAMEOFFAMILIAR has become practically second nature.

For the next twenty minutes, you and Meredith take turns sending your familiars zipping all around campus. By the end of the training exercise, controlling $NAMEOFFAMILIAR has become practically second nature.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whoo... That's totally fun, but it's really exhausting!

nodes.speaker: Nameoffamiliar
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, but you did great!

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Try not to break your arm patting yourself on the back or anything...

nodes.speaker: Nameoffamiliar
nodes.text: Mrrr?

options.label: Put Priam's hand on the book!
Put your hand on the book!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What? ...What are you even talking about?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: The diadem for the Mo'Anna Invocation. It's been `stolen`, and you're the only student who knows where it's kept. That means `you` took it!
nodes.text_bbcode: The diadem for the Mo'Anna Invocation. It's been [color=#e23b3b][i]stolen[/i][/color], and you're the only student who knows where it's kept. That means [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] took it!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $CADY. I tried to explain that he's imagining things, that I must've misplaced it...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: But Priam is not listening to reason right now!

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Silence, sister! The mistake was yours in trusting this thief. Now let me make it right!
Priam reaches out to grab you, and you yank your arm free!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Don't you `dare` touch me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you [color=#3b78e2][i]dare[/i][/color] touch me!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Priam, she's right! Just calm down for a second!
Priam takes a step back, eyeing the room like a hunter encircled by wolves.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I see what's happening... I had hoped you'd surrender yourself willingly, but trust this, one way or the other, you `will` face justice.
nodes.text_bbcode: I see what's happening... I had hoped you'd surrender yourself willingly, but trust this, one way or the other, you [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] face justice.

nodes.text: Priam raises his palms toward you!

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: `Custo... Cal... Cus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Custo... Cal... Cus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A swirling, pulsating ball of energy forms directly in front of Priam and expands! Luke backs up...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Wh-what's he doing?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: He's casting a Stone Cage spell to paralyze you! It's powerful but slow! If you're quick, you can counter with a spell of your own!
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Your sister is old enough to make her own decisions.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: That may be so, but she's also trusting enough to allow a charming `thief` access to the treasures in our room.
nodes.text_bbcode: That may be so, but she's also trusting enough to allow a charming [color=#e23b3b][i]thief[/i][/color] access to the treasures in our room.

nodes.text: Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You're not the boss of me `or` her.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not the boss of me [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] her.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: No, I'm not an authority over my sister, but I `have` sworn to protect her...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I'm not an authority over my sister, but I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] sworn to protect her...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: From the corrupting influence of this world, and also from `thieves` who would abuse her trusting nature.
nodes.text_bbcode: From the corrupting influence of this world, and also from [color=#e23b3b][i]thieves[/i][/color] who would abuse her trusting nature.

nodes.text: A bolt of lightning sparks across the table, striking the ping-pong ball mid-air... And blasting it directly into Brian and Pietro's cup!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: The words are... `Electro... Con... Ductus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The words are... [color=#e23b3b][i]Electro... Con... Ductus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Electro... Con... Ductus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Electro... Con... Ductus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Got it?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I think so.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Cool. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I already made up my mind...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sure, if you think it would be better, I can change it up.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Good choice! Air spells are aligned with Order. You seem pretty in tune with your alignment...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Uh, are you sure? Air spells are aligned with Order, and you seem kind of `impulsive.` And I mean that as a compliment...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, are you sure? Air spells are aligned with Order, and you seem kind of [color=#e23b3b][i]impulsive.[/i][/color] And I mean that as a compliment...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Right, well...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Good choice! Electricity is aligned with Chaos. You seem pretty in tune with your alignment...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Cool. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sure, if you think it would be better, I can change it up.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I already made up my mind...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Uh, are you sure? Electricity is aligned with Chaos, and you seem kind of `thoughtful.` And I mean that as a compliment...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, are you sure? Electricity is aligned with Chaos, and you seem kind of [color=#e23b3b][i]thoughtful.[/i][/color] And I mean that as a compliment...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Right, well...
Later that night...

Heavy bass beats pulse from the door of Rebelban House. Guys and girls mill about on the front lawn, chatting and casually sipping from red, plastic goblets. Nearby, familiars gambol in the branches of a massive elm.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Are you absolutely certain this is the right place? The atmosphere seems overly joyful for a hanging...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, you mean 'hanging out'...?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That doesn't really mean there will be a `literal` hanging. Just people chilling. Which doesn't involve anyone being actually chilled...
nodes.text_bbcode: That doesn't really mean there will be a [color=#3b78e2][i]literal[/i][/color] hanging. Just people chilling. Which doesn't involve anyone being actually chilled...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah... We really need to get you on the internet.
There is a wild yell from overhead!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `LOOK OUT BELOW!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]LOOK OUT BELOW!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You and Arinna look up to see Luke jumping off the roof!
He hurtles skyward, crests against the moonlit sky, and then screams downward like a mortar!
At the very last second, Luke yells magic words--

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `SILEX DE MUTO!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]SILEX DE MUTO!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The concrete walkway in front of you transforms into a hot tub! Luke splashes down unharmed. Partygoers whoop and cheer!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Luke, that was so awesome! I got it all on video and--
Simon notices you and Arinna walking up.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Hey, Arinna, Cady, you guys made it!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Was there ever any doubt?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh, uh... I guess I thought maybe Priam would object.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: What my brother doesn't know will not hurt him. He believes that I am studying Hobgoblin Mythology with Lorekeeper Quillum.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Awesome! Er, I mean, that you came. Not studying lore--

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Unless you think that's awesome. In which case, funny, so do I...?
Luke splashes water from the hot tub in your direction.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hey! $CADY, little help here!
You reach down to help Luke up. He grips your hand tightly, and you--
Your feet slide on the wet concrete along the edge of the hot tub, and you splash down into the water right on top of Luke!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `AHH...` Pfftt... Glrrg...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHH...[/i][/color] Pfftt... Glrrg...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Whoa... $CADY, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, let me get this straight. You can make a hot tub appear out of thin air, but you can't make the edge of the tub no-slip?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I... I probably I should've magicked in a guard rail...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I'll remember that if I get selected to perform on stage at the Winter Dance.
Luke pulls himself out of the hot tub and then helps you out. You shiver in the cool night air.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: G-g-great party, g-g-guys...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: You look cold. Maybe we should get you inside...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: G-g-good idea...
You help Luke out of the water, and you can't help but notice the way the water presses the fabric of his shirt against his lean, muscular torso.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Nice...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: ...Nice?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... That was actually a pretty... Nice... Trick.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Thanks, I've been working on a few different spells in case I get selected to perform on stage at the Winter Dance.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Luke's just being modest. He's a shoo-in to get picked.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I do not understand. From here, Luke's shoes appear to be on his feet.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: It's kind of complicated, Arinna. And it's also a little cold out here. Maybe we should head inside?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, that could work.

The four of you turn and head into the house. As you enter, the hot tub bubbles away into nothingness. Blades of grass sprout and cover the patch of dirt. A moment later, four high-heel clad feet step into view.
Minka and Meredith, both in sheer, shimmery cocktail dresses, watch you and Luke vanish inside. Minka has her arms folded tightly across her chest, and her lips are drawn into a sneer.

Inside, the party is in full swing. In one corner, a student DJ scratches an MP3 player like it was vinyl on top of an old-school gramophone. In another corner, couples nestle in plush armchairs, making out heavily while heart-shaped bubbles float and burst in the air above...
Luke nods toward a nearby staircase.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Simon, do you mind showing Arinna around? $CADY and I need to go dry off.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, no problem!
Simon and Arinna wander off together, and you and Luke go upstairs. A few minutes later, you're both in the second-story hallway drying yourselves off with bath towels.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, so... Couldn't you just air-dry us with magic?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Simon, do you mind showing Arinna around? I need to go dry off.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What about me?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: You can keep me company.
Simon and Arinna wander off together, and you and Luke go upstairs. A few minutes later, you're both in the second-story hallway, and he's drying himself off with a bath towel.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, so... Couldn't you just air-dry yourself with magic?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I `could`, but Simon and Arinna looked like they wanted some alone time, so I thought we'd disappear up here.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color], but Simon and Arinna looked like they wanted some alone time, so I thought we'd disappear up here.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So you noticed about Simon...?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: We `are` friends. Plus, it's kind of hard to miss...
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] friends. Plus, it's kind of hard to miss...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: And I'd be lying if I said that I hadn't been looking forward to spending more time with you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Why? Looking for trouble?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I think I can handle whatever you can dish out.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I don't know. I've got some exes who might say otherwise.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Anyway, there's lots of other fun stuff to do at this party. There's dancing, food if you're hungry, or there's even--
There's a yelp! The floor shakes, and a flailing guy comes sliding down the hall, grinding to a halt right at your feet.
Two other guys peek into the hall, grinning at the first guy now laying prone beside you.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Game over, dawg!

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: Next time, remember to wear a helmet!
The guy on the ground looks up, moans wearily, and then falls back onto his butt, beaten.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Luke, what just happened? Was that a magic fight?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Kind of. This guy just lost at `Spell Pong...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Kind of. This guy just lost at [color=#e23b3b][i]Spell Pong...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Spell Pong?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: It's just a game some of the guys play...

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Just a `game?` Don't let him fool you. Spell Pong is way more than just a game, and Luke is practically the champion of the whole school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just a [color=#e23b3b][i]game?[/i][/color] Don't let him fool you. Spell Pong is way more than just a game, and Luke is practically the champion of the whole school.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Really? I'd like to see that.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Guys, I would, but Simon is busy, and it's two to a team so--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'll play.

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: Great! It's a match then!

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Game on!
Luke turns his back to the two guys and whispers to you.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: $CADY, this game isn't exactly 'Approved by the Administration'...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Some of the spells we use are pretty powerful and could cause a lot of damage if miscast.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: If Headmaster Cromwell finds out you've been playing, you could get in a lot of trouble...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh my! I'd never intentionally do anything improper!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Right... But this is also a game of spells, and you don't really know anything more than the basics...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, so teach me... Or do you think I can't handle myself?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: No, but--
The two guys take position at a nearby ping-pong table.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: What's it going to be, Luke? You in for the next match?

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: Or are you chicken?
Luke turns back to the guys, blue eyes steely.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `...We're in.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...We're in.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A few minutes later, you and Luke stand in front of the ping-pong table. One red plastic goblet is placed at either end. Brian and Pietro are opposite you. All around is a cheering crowd of students, eager for the match to begin.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Okay, so the object of the game is to get your ping-pong ball into the cup on the opposite side.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That doesn't sound so tough...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Well, it wouldn't be, except--
Luke picks up a ping-pong ball and flicks it gently across the table.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: `Typhon Turbi Nus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Typhon Turbi Nus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brian swipes at the air with his ping-pong paddle, and the ball is caught mid-air by a small tornado.

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: `Electro Con Ductus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Electro Con Ductus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Pietro makes a similar vertical slice, and a bolt of lightning strikes the ball.
It splats down at the center of the table, melted into a gooey puddle of sizzling, blackened plastic.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah... So maybe this `was` a bad idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... So maybe this [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] a bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Listen, I know this seems hard, but we can still do this. I'm good enough to handle defense by myself. But you'll need to make the kill shot.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: With magic...?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Brian and Pietro are using `Wind Weave` and `Spark Whip.` Both of those spells are effective and pretty easy to cast. All you'd have to do is remember the words...
nodes.text_bbcode: Brian and Pietro are using [color=#e23b3b][i]Wind Weave[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]Spark Whip.[/i][/color] Both of those spells are effective and pretty easy to cast. All you'd have to do is remember the words...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Which do you want to learn?
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR yips excitedly and takes to the air!
A few seconds later, she flies back, carrying a heavy brown paper lunch sack in her jaws. From across the yard comes yelling!

nodes.speaker: Groundskeeper
nodes.text: Oy! Where'd me lunch go?! I swear, I've had it up to my sideburns with you meddlesome urchins!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Ugh, you're such a disaster...
Beastmaster Kimuko walks over, not amused.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: $CADY, if you don't mind, the groundskeeper would like his lunch back.

For the next twenty minutes, you and Simon take turns sending your familiars zipping all around campus. By the end of the training exercise, you've managed to convince $NAMEOFFAMILIAR to return the stick, more or less...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Don't worry. You'll get the hang of it eventually... Probably?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Thanks for the support.

For the next twenty minutes, you and Meredith take turns sending your familiars zipping all around campus. By the end of the training exercise, you've managed to convince $NAMEOFFAMILIAR to return the stick, more or less...

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Ugh, just give up already...
Beastmaster Kimuko takes position behind the row of students.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Remember everyone, your familiar is an extension of `you.` Think about what you want it to do, and it'll follow your lead.
nodes.text_bbcode: Remember everyone, your familiar is an extension of [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color] Think about what you want it to do, and it'll follow your lead.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Now on the count of three. One... Two... `THREE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now on the count of three. One... Two... [color=#3b78e2][i]THREE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Each team hurls a stick skyward. At the apex of their flight, the sticks' buzzing wings catch on the breeze, and the sticks zip off across campus like dragonflies!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whoa... Uh, okay, $NAMEOFFAMILIAR! Go `fetch`, girl!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa... Uh, okay, $NAMEOFFAMILIAR! Go [color=#3b78e2][i]fetch[/i][/color], girl!

nodes.text: $NAMEOFFAMILIAR cocks her head to the side quizzically.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Um, I don't think it's working...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Sure, it is. Remember what Professor Kimuko said. Your familiar is an extension of `you.` Just think about what you want it to do, and it'll do it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, it is. Remember what Professor Kimuko said. Your familiar is an extension of [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] Just think about what you want it to do, and it'll do it...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, I'll try...

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Seriously? It's not that hard. Just remember what Professor Kimuko said. Your familiar is an extension of `you.` Think about what you want it to do, and it'll do it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously? It's not that hard. Just remember what Professor Kimuko said. Your familiar is an extension of [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color] Think about what you want it to do, and it'll do it...

nodes.text: You close your eyes and concentrate on the stick...
You jump back, dropping the stick to the ground and then stomping it into tiny pieces!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: $CADY, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Killing the demonic, crawling stick creature?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: You mean... The helpful, friendly Magic Stick we needed to do our training exercise?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: When you put it like that, it does sound bad... Do we need to get another?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: And give Beastmaster Kimuko a chance to yell at us? No way!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Besides, I think I can fix it...
Simon ducks down. He places his hands over the stick and mutters. There is a bright flash, and when Simon, retracts his hand, the stick limps around.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Not perfect... But better than nothing!

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: OMG, you're such a freak! We needed that to do our training exercise...
Meredith jerks her hand skyward!

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Professor Kimuko, $CADY broke our Magic Stick.
Beastmaster Kimuko shakes her head disapprovingly and hands you a new one. This time, when it twitches, you stay calm.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: You get a pass this time because you're new, but if something like this happens again...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It won't...

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: It better not.
You hold perfectly still, allowing the tiny stick to feel its way around your palm...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Weird... It's all twitchy and buggy! What is it?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's a Magic Stick... For playing fetch.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Couldn't we just use a regular stick?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Sure, if you had a regular pet, but $NAMEOFFAMILIAR isn't regular, is she?

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Duh, it's a Magic Stick...` For playing fetch.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Couldn't we just use a regular stick?

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Do you know anything about familiars at all?
A few minutes later, you and your partner line up together while Beastmaster Kimuko distributes equipment.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: The first trick we're going to practice is `fetch...`
nodes.text_bbcode: The first trick we're going to practice is [color=#3b78e2][i]fetch...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Beastmaster Kimuko places a small stick in your hands, and as it touches the flesh of your palm--
The stick jerks, extending spindly legs and translucent, veiny, leaf-like wings! It looks up and chitters!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh, I see. Then you two are paired together?
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, but look on the bright side. Cromwell wanted you to meet new people, and you already know us...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...Yes, I suppose you're right! Thank you, $CADY.
Arinna walks off into the group, finally teaming up with Meredith. When she is out of earshot, Simon finally breathes...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: What did you do that for? That was finally my chance to talk to her, and you ruined it!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Talk? You could barely breathe, goofus!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: The way I see it, I did you a `favor.` Another 30 seconds of spazzing out like that, and Arinna would never date you!
nodes.text_bbcode: The way I see it, I did you a [color=#3b78e2][i]favor.[/i][/color] Another 30 seconds of spazzing out like that, and Arinna would never date you!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess you're right. Anyway, what's done is done. There's no changing it now...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...I should?
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well yeah, like you said, you're the expert, and Simon needs a lot of help because he's, uh... Um... Terrified of...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Getting fleas?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Then it is very fortunate for you that I know a secret family recipe to ward off biting insects!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: What `don't` you know?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] you know?

nodes.text: Arinna yanks Simon by the wrist and drags him off toward the perimeter of the forest. As he is pulled away, Simon flashes a thumbs up with his free hand.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Awesome... Loverboy's all taken care of, but I still don't have a partner.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: $CADY, why don't you work with Meredith? She needs a partner too.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Meredith?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Just perfect...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Gaudy, but I guess it matches my mood...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And speaking of `matching...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And speaking of [color=#3b78e2][i]matching...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Out of the corner of your eye, you spy your pet `familiar` $NAMEOFFAMILIAR stir where she sleeps on top of a tall bookshelf...
nodes.text_bbcode: Out of the corner of your eye, you spy your pet [b]familiar[/b] $NAMEOFFAMILIAR stir where she sleeps on top of a tall bookshelf...

nodes.speaker: Drakeling
nodes.text: KssSSSss!!!

nodes.speaker: Birdmonkey
nodes.text: Eeee Eeee!!!

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: Snrrt Snnrrt?

nodes.speaker: Eagle Badger
nodes.text: Grrrsquawk!

nodes.speaker: Cat Bat
nodes.text: Skreeow? Skreeow?
Your $TYPEOFFAMILIAR stretches, spreads her wings, and alights. She circles around the room and touches down on your shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hee! Stop licking my ear!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Ahem... $CADY, I apologize for interrupting...
Your eyes pivot to the door, where you spy your roommate peeking in.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Good morning, `Princess!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Good morning, [color=#3b78e2][i]Princess![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I have asked you to refer to me by my given name, Arinna.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And do I ever do what I'm told?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I suppose not...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: But as to the `quality` of the morning, you might revise your estimate once you inspect your screeching timepiece. Are you not tardy for Familiar Training?
nodes.text_bbcode: But as to the [color=#3b78e2][i]quality[/i][/color] of the morning, you might revise your estimate once you inspect your screeching timepiece. Are you not tardy for Familiar Training?

nodes.text: The alarm clock by your bed blinks ominously. The time displayed is 8:32. Two minutes `after` your class is scheduled to begin...
nodes.text_bbcode: The alarm clock by your bed blinks ominously. The time displayed is 8:32. Two minutes [b]after[/b] your class is scheduled to begin...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'm late... `I'm late!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm late... [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm late![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You yank on your sneakers and are halfway out the front door when you stick your head back in. Inside, Arinna is placing the Mo'Anna diadem back into its jeweled lockbox.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY, the class is Familiar Training. You wouldn't want to forget your--
You point a hurried finger at $NAMEOFFAMILIAR!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You! Come on!
A few minutes later...
You stand with the rest of your Beast Mastery class on the open field at the bottom of the hill, each of you accompanied by a familiar.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Now listen up, ya roughnecks. I know you're prouder than peacocks about all the magic spells you've been casting, but a `familiar` is a magician's most important asset...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now listen up, ya roughnecks. I know you're prouder than peacocks about all the magic spells you've been casting, but a [color=#3b78e2][i]familiar[/i][/color] is a magician's most important asset...

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: It's a second set of eyes and ears. It's teeth and claws. And it can get to places too high up for you to reach or too small for you for you to fit into...

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: It's no exaggeration to say that a well-trained familiar could someday save your life, so that's what we're here to do... `Train well.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's no exaggeration to say that a well-trained familiar could someday save your life, so that's what we're here to do... [color=#3b78e2][i]Train well.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Looking around the field, you see a few faces you know...
A few you don't...
And a few you wish you didn't...
Simon leans in, whispering.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Geez, did you set fire to Minka's handbag or something? She's been glowering at you for like fifteen minutes straight!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: She might've had a run-in with $NAMEOFFAMILIAR a few nights ago...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And also every night since...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Turns out I'm very good at holding a grudge!
Beastmaster Kimuko paces back to the center of the group.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Now, I'd like you all to pair off into groups of two for the first set of exercises.
Luke jogs over to you and Simon. His familiar, a winged serpent named Cornelius, coils effortlessly through the air overhead.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hey, $CADY, since you're still new to this, I was thinking that you and I should partner up.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, Luke, that sounds really--

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Luke, front and center!
Beastmaster Kimuko calls out from the other side of the group. Minka is standing next to her, cradling her white Persian cat bat and sniffling tearily.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Uh... Yes ma'am?

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: You've already mastered these beginner lessons, and Minka's familiar is feeling under the weather.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Would you mind accompanying her to the Infirmary to get everything checked out?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Yeah, no problem...
Luke walks over to Minka, and together they stroll up the hill toward the main building. At the top of the hill, Minka glares back at you... Her tears suddenly vanishing into a sly grin.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What?! That total b--

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Aw, it's not so bad. We could partner up.
Simon pets an old, floppy-eared dachshund with patchy fur and somewhat bent wings. It pants, wheezing for breath...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Turns out I actually know a thing or two about familiars...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...As do I.
You and Simon spin around to see Princess Arinna T'Karra stride up.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Arinna, you're, um-- Uh-- Are you actually taking a class with us?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Headmaster Cromwell suggested that I interact more regularly with my fellow students, and given my first-hand experience with creatures of the Wilde, this class seemed like a natural fit.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, er... I mean, it sure is! A good fit! Howdyhoo! Why can I not stop talking?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY, given that we are neighbors, I thought you might like to be my partner?
Simon turns to you, panicked! From deep within his throat comes a burbling, choking sound!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Glllrggg--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, actually, Arinna...
Order Up!
Chaos Up!
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR swoops in and snatches away the diadem an instant before the gryphon reaches Arinna! The gryphon hesitates and sniffs, immediately disoriented...

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: Hrr...?
It pulls out of the dive and arcs up! Below, Arinna falls to her knees, panting for air.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, I... I think so...
You hear feet rush up from behind and then a chorus of voices cry out!

nodes.speaker: Nameoffamiliar
nodes.text: Rrrr...

nodes.speaker: Nameoffamiliar
nodes.text: Skreeoww!

nodes.speaker: Nameoffamiliar
nodes.text: Prrrrr!
Later that night, in the bowels of the school, a cloaked figure draws an ornate silver hand mirror from within the folds of fabric and speaks magic words...
The figure speaks into the glass. The reflective surface ripples and then solidifies, becoming a portal into the Wilde...

nodes.speaker: Cloaked Figure
nodes.text: Apologies for the delay, Master. I made contact as soon as I was able. Unfortunately, the attempt to eliminate Arinna proved unsuccessful.
In the glass is the man made of shadow, the Doombringer, sitting on his throne inside his cavernous throne room...

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: You make me wait `weeks` for news of failure?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You make me wait [color=#e23b3b][i]weeks[/i][/color] for news of failure?!

nodes.speaker: Cloaked Figure
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Master, as I said--

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: Excuses!

nodes.speaker: Cloaked Figure
nodes.text: Sir, there `is` something else. Something of note. There's a new student at this school: $CADY. She helped Arinna survive...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sir, there [i]is[/i] something else. Something of note. There's a new student at this school: $CADY. She helped Arinna survive...

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: And how is this girl any concern of mine?

nodes.speaker: Cloaked Figure
nodes.text: She's a `Wildewalker...`
nodes.text_bbcode: She's a [i]Wildewalker...[/i]

nodes.text: The mirror glass ripples, as the shadowy figure on the other side turns aside in thought...

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: If this is so, then your orders must change. This girl... This $CADY... She may prove the key to all my plans...

nodes.speaker: Doombringer
nodes.text: You must gain her trust, keep her close, become her `intimate` companion...
nodes.text_bbcode: You must gain her trust, keep her close, become her [color=#e23b3b][i]intimate[/i][/color] companion...

nodes.text: The cloaked figure pulls back the hood, revealing his smiling, handsome face.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Yeah, I think I can handle that.
The surface of the glass ripples one last time and then solidifies, a mirror once more.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: In fact, it'll be my pleasure...
You've reached the end of `Magic School Book 2.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You've reached the end of [b]Magic School Book 2.[/b]

nodes.text: Your final score is %d out of 100 points.

format.pattern: Your final score is %d out of 100 points.

nodes.text: Your final alignment is %d% Order and %d% Chaos.

format.pattern: Your final alignment is %d% Order and %d% Chaos.

nodes.text: Your final alignment is %d% Chaos and %d% Order.

format.pattern: Your final alignment is %d% Chaos and %d% Order.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Eh, let me think about it.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Very well then, if there's nothing else?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Actually, I... I was kind of wondering about something. I didn't steal anything, and I didn't release the animals from the Bestiary... But `who did?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, I... I was kind of wondering about something. I didn't steal anything, and I didn't release the animals from the Bestiary... But [color=#3b78e2][i]who did?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ah, I see.  A valid question, but one with an answer that is not your concern...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: For now, simply know that your actions have met reward, and your place here at SpellClaive Academy is assured...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Thank you, Headmaster.
You turn and exit out into the hallway...
...Reaching the quad just as the final bell of the day rings out. Luke, Simon, and Arinna are among the students spilling out into the evening air.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hey, $CADY, check it out! Simon screwed up his transformation spell and gave himself humongous frog feet...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Really, how...?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I spilled ketchup on the pronunciation guide.
Simon looks down at the green webbed toes ripping their way out through the canvas fabric of his skate shoes. He twitches and leaps into the air!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: `Ahh...` Why did I even do that? Now I'm jumping for no reason!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ahh...[/i][/color] Why did I even do that? Now I'm jumping for no reason!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: In the Wilde, we have an uncle who was so transformed. He scoured the countryside for a kiss that would free him from the curse...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: So all I need is a kiss? `...Arinna?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So all I need is a kiss? [color=#e23b3b][i]...Arinna?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A humongous dragonfly zips by. Simon turns his head, and a giant tongue flicks out. It ensnares the bug and retracts. Before he can stop himself, Simon swallows!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: `Ggghh... Hllkkk...` Why did I do that?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ggghh... Hllkkk...[/i][/color] Why did I do that?!

nodes.text: Simon drops to his knees and gags.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Perhaps we should search for a different cure...
Arinna looks up at the clouds gathering overhead.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: For now, we should get you to the Infirmary before it starts to rain...
Arinna escorts Simon toward the main building. You and Luke hang back. He turns to you...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: So $CADY, you don't seem like the kind of girl who puts names on things, but you've got to admit that you and me have something special...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Really? You're going to talk?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Nope. Just an observation. And `this...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nope. Just an observation. And [color=#e23b3b][i]this...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Luke wraps his arms around your waist and pulls you into a long, tender kiss.
Overhead, Cornelius and $NAMEOFFAMILIAR zip about, dodging the first few raindrops falling from the sky.
There's a crash from over by the door. Simon is on his knees, rubbing his head. There's a crack in the top of the doorframe...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Guys? Still can't control the jumping... Little help?
As a group, you assist Simon inside, laughing and poking fun as you go. None of you notice that you're being `watched` from above...
nodes.text_bbcode: As a group, you assist Simon inside, laughing and poking fun as you go. None of you notice that you're being [b]watched[/b] from above...

nodes.text: Priam stands at the window of Cromwell's office, his keen eyes observing your exit...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: 'Of no concern'...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Need I remind you that an agent of the Doombringer made attempt on the life of the Princess of the Wilde from `within` these walls...
nodes.text_bbcode: Need I remind you that an agent of the Doombringer made attempt on the life of the Princess of the Wilde from [color=#e23b3b][i]within[/i][/color] these walls...

nodes.text: Cromwell steps up next to Priam, his eyes also on your group.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I believe I told you it was 'none of `her` concern', and that is still very much true...
nodes.text_bbcode: I believe I told you it was 'none of [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] concern', and that is still very much true...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But make no mistake, I `am` concerned.
nodes.text_bbcode: But make no mistake, I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] concerned.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Someone at this school, someone `trusted`, someone unknown, conspires to aid the Doombringer in conquering the Wilde...
nodes.text_bbcode: Someone at this school, someone [color=#3b78e2][i]trusted[/i][/color], someone unknown, conspires to aid the Doombringer in conquering the Wilde...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And if the Wilde falls beneath the crush of his boot, then `this world` will surely fall after.
nodes.text_bbcode: And if the Wilde falls beneath the crush of his boot, then [color=#3b78e2][i]this world[/i][/color] will surely fall after.

nodes.text: Cromwell turns to Priam, eyes narrowed, serious...
Outside, thunderclouds gather, casting dark shadows and spitting rain against the window.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: These are dark times, Priam, and they grow darker with each passing day...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And until the traitor is uncovered, the life of every single student at this school is at risk...
Lightning flashes, thunder cracks, rain pours...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: If that is your desire, it would be my duty to relate to any and all that you are, ahem... Awesome.
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And also very pretty.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Yes, and also very pretty.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And in a fair fight I could totally kick your a--

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: `Enough!` Is that your wish?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Enough![/i][/color] Is that your wish?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: You overstep yourself, `girl...`
nodes.text_bbcode: You overstep yourself, [color=#e23b3b][i]girl...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So then you're going back on your word?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Yes, $CADY, it... It is within the power of the royal court transform me into a monkey... `Temporarily.` Is that indeed your wish?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, $CADY, it... It is within the power of the royal court transform me into a monkey... [color=#e23b3b][i]Temporarily.[/i][/color] Is that indeed your wish?

nodes.text: Cromwell opens the door further and motions for you to enter.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Now please do come into my office. I have something of a surprise for you.
You step inside and spy Priam waiting near Cromwell's desk, his taut, feline face locked in an awkward, puckered grimace. He nods to you.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Mistress $CADY.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You better mean 'miss'...
Cromwell coughs and steps between you two.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Ahem... Priam and I were just discussing how much progress you've made since you arrived at the school, and how very brave you were defending Arinna during the disruption.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: As far as the Council is concerned, you've more than earned your place at SpellClaive.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I also hear you've regained the trust of the other students?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: More or less... Minka being less.
Cromwell chuckles.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Patience, she may yet prove herself a formidable ally.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Now, as to why you're here. Priam has something to give to you. Don't you, Precept?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I do? ...Oh right.
Priam's voice is high and thin, like air escaping from a tiny hole in an inflated balloon.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And you were going to give it to her now? Were you not?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I was...
Priam sighs. From within his robe, he retrieves a small scroll, and then unfurls it. He reads the words printed there...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: 'For service rendered to the Wildefolk at great personal risk, I offer thee `one boon.`'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'For service rendered to the Wildefolk at great personal risk, I offer thee [color=#e23b3b][i]one boon.[/i][/color]'

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: A boon is like a favor...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I can ask you for anything, and you'd `have` to do it?
nodes.text_bbcode: I can ask you for anything, and you'd [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to do it?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: If it is within the power of the royal court to accommodate your request, it shall be done promptly and with conviction...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So I could ask you to...
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I didn't mean to. I went for the jar of fireflax and accidentally picked up blazeblossom instead...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: An easy mistake. One I made myself many years ago...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Did you know the Potions Room `used` to have a thatch roof?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you know the Potions Room [color=#3b78e2][i]used[/i][/color] to have a thatch roof?

nodes.text: Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: There was a giant green mushroom cloud! I'm totally going to try to recreate the formula this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, but I'll do it `outside`, of course...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, but I'll do it [color=#3b78e2][i]outside[/i][/color], of course...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That `does` seem the wiser course of action. And I do believe that Buttwerst would appreciate it.
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] seem the wiser course of action. And I do believe that Buttwerst would appreciate it.

nodes.text: You sit outside Cromwell's office, fingers toying nervously with the hall pass that summoned you here. You can't help but remember that day all those months ago when you first arrived.
Several weeks later...
In your mind, you flash back, remembering the terrifying beast that has pursued you.

nodes.speaker: Beast
nodes.text: `RAAAWWWRRR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]RAAAWWWRRR!!![/i]

nodes.text: Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You're right, Headmaster. It is risky, even more risky than we've talked about...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I don't know how or why, but I think there's something in the Wilde that's been pursuing me...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I see... We'll discuss this later.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: What is she talking about, Cromwell? Is she seriously suggesting that she's been to the Wilde? But that's impossible! That would make her a...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...A `Wildewalker!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...A [color=#3b78e2][i]Wildewalker![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: What `what` now?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#e23b3b][i]what[/i][/color] now?

nodes.text: A surprised mumble races through the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: That will be enough, Priam. And as for you, $CADY, in my opinion, you've been brave enough for a single night. You should get some rest.
Cromwell calls out to the assembled group.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: In fact... You should `all` get some rest! Quickly then, need I remind you that tomorrow is a school day?
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact... You should [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] get some rest! Quickly then, need I remind you that tomorrow is a school day?

nodes.text: The crowd grumbles and disperses until all the students but you and Luke have returned to their rooms.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: So... You're really a Wildewalker?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I think that's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You... You do?
Luke leans in and kisses your cheek.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: We'll talk more about it later, okay? I should get back to my room before Headmaster Cromwell turns me into an owl for staying out too late...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You are correct, Luke. And $CADY, it's time for you to return to your room as well...
Cromwell glances back to where the gryphon lies moaning.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Things must now be done that I doubt a kind soul like you would care to witness...
You turn, walk to your room, and try to put the gryphon out of your mind.
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I understand the risks, Headmaster, but the gryphon shouldn't be punished for what someone else did.
You step toward the felled gryphon, kneel, and concentrate, doing your best to recall the feeling of panic that proceeded all your previous jumps.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: What is she doing, Headmaster? How can you allow this mockery to continue for even a second?
The world blurs, you feel for a moment like you are falling, and when you look up again, you and the gryphon are no longer on the grounds of the school.
The gryphon staggers to its feet. It beats its wings and jumps into the air with a mighty screech.

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKREEEEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKREEEEE!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I did it! I actually did!
A raking pain shoots through the flesh of your back! Something warm and sticky spills down the back of your legs...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ahhh...` What just...?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhh...[/i][/color] What just...?

nodes.text: You turn and a sinister face glares down at you.

nodes.speaker: Beast
nodes.text: `RAAAWWWRRR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]RAAAWWWRRR!!![/i]

nodes.text: You drop to your knees and fall through worlds, landing once again in the courtyard of SpellClaive Academy.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: ...Was a Wildewalker in this school this whole time, and you didn't think I'd `care` to know about it?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Was a Wildewalker in this school this whole time, and you didn't think I'd [color=#e23b3b][i]care[/i][/color] to know about it?

nodes.text: Cromwell looks past Priam, eyes turning to where you lie unmoving on the ground...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Step aside. $CADY, are you all right? ...$CADY?
You grow lightheaded. Words are spoken to you, but they seem fuzzy, undifferentiated from each other. The world fades around you.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `Custo...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Custo...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cal...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: `Cus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Cus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The three guys aim their collective Stone Cage spell skyward! The gryphon is paralyzed mid-air!

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKREEE...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKREEE...[/i]

nodes.text: Its wings beat as if underwater, and the gryphon rotates into a spiraling nosedive.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh oh, I think it's coming this way...
Luke hefts you to your feet. Together, you turn and flee, joining Priam and Simon!
A shadow passes overhead! Priam and Simon leap away. Luke is to your right, directly in its path...
You reach over, grab Luke by the collar, and--
--Yank him to the side, just as the gryphon crashes down and digs a trench in the lawn!
Together, you both roll over one another, until you come to a stop on top of him.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `Oof...` That was close.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof...[/i][/color] That was close.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, it was!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: So why are you smiling?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Because the last time something almost ran us over, you were saving me!
Luke laughs and hops to his feet. He helps you up.
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR swoops down from overhead and alights on your shoulder. It deposits the Mo'anna diadem into your hands.
Simon, Priam, and Arinna step back over. Behind them walk up Cromwell, Spellmaster Ang, Beastmaster Kimuko, and the rest of the faculty. Circling around is the rest of the student body.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: $CADY, are you all right?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, I think so.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: As is my sister, thanks to you.
Arinna eyes her brother, coolly.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...And?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: And I am sorry for the accusations I made. You have proven yourself an ally to the Court of the Wilde.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And she will receive our highest commendation!

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: She... She will?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes. She will, brother, or have you forgotten who rules the Court in Exile?
Priam glares at you. His grimace relaxes, and he bows graciously. You offer him the diadem.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: ...As you wish, Princess.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Heh... Look who's slack-jawed now!
The gryphon stirs, moaning slightly. Beastmaster Kimuko steps over and takes a knee beside it. She strokes its head...

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `Uhrrr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Uhrrr![/i]

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Poor thing. Look at him...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Aw, I feel bad. It didn't mean to hurt any of us. Somebody made the gryphon do it. They used a Faunafurreus Elixir.

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: I... I knew my chemicals were stolen!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Now's not the time, Leopold.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: $CADY, you're certain of this?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: She `is...`
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#3b78e2][i]is...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Sadly for the gryphon, it makes little difference. This poor beast's mind has already been bent to the purpose of another. It must now be put down.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh... And we can't just set it free?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Here, in `our` world? That's simply not possible...
nodes.text_bbcode: Here, in [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] world? That's simply not possible...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What about in the Wilde?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Preposterous! Opening a portal to the Wilde would take our greatest sorcerers months to accomplish. To think that we would waste effort on this beast that attacked our Princess...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I wasn't talking to you. Headmaster?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: If there `was` a way to set the gryphon free in the Wilde, it might survive there and possibly even thrive...
nodes.text_bbcode: If there [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] a way to set the gryphon free in the Wilde, it might survive there and possibly even thrive...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But even if you could summon the will, traveling between worlds bears tremendous risk...
Headmaster Cromwell turns to you, shaking her head over so slightly from side to side.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I cannot advise it.
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR hesitates mid-air, immediately confused. She banks left and then right...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh no... $NAMEOFFAMILIAR, look out!

Your $TYPEOFFAMILIAR careens headlong toward the wide-open beak of the gryphon. The gryphon bites down with a sickening crunch, shakes $NAMEOFFAMILIAR violently back and forth in its jaws, and swallows...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You strain to cast another spell--
But the gryphon is already upon Arinna. It snatches the princess up and swoops into the air, rising higher and higher until it passes in front of the moon.
There, cast in stark silhouette, it releases Arinna. She drops like a stone. There is a distant, haunting scream followed by a sickening thunk.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, I'm sorry... I tried...
You run to where her body lays and collapse to your knees beside her, sobbing, failing to notice that the gryphon has circled back around and is now headed right your direction...
You have failed.
