nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: The diadem begins to fall away... But hangs on by one last leather strap!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh no! It didn't work! Arinna, keep running!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Huff... Is that human sarcasm?
The gryphon circles back around for another pass at Arinna! You struggle to rise to your feet...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I don't think I have the strength to cast another spell...
The world seems to slow down. Arinna, her feet pounding on the lawn, breath heavy. The gryphon shrieking as it barrels toward her from the sky.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I don't know what to do...
And then...
A tiny, winged familiar streaks like a comet from across the quad, moving straight for the gryphon!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: $NAMEOFFAMILIAR... Go for the diadem! `...Go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $NAMEOFFAMILIAR... Go for the diadem! [color=#3b78e2][i]...Go![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You close your eyes and concentrate...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Just concentrate and say the words... `Electro... Con... Ductus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just concentrate and say the words... [color=#e23b3b][i]Electro... Con... Ductus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I think so...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What about `Spark Whip?` I was learning how to cast it right before your big bro tossed me off the balcony at the party.
nodes.text_bbcode: What about [color=#3b78e2][i]Spark Whip?[/i][/color] I was learning how to cast it right before your big bro tossed me off the balcony at the party.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: The gryphon tracks us by smell. All we have done is bought ourselves time...
A beam of moonlight glints off the gryphon's shoulder, illuminating a band of shiny silver tied to the gryphon's body with leather cords.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Wait a second... Do you see that?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY, that is the missing Mo'anna diadem... But why would it be tethered to a gryphon?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Why?
...Why?
Your mind drifts back to your lessons at the Bestiary...

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: It's like I always say, gryphons are bloodhounds with beaks. They get an object to scent from, and they can track anybody anywhere.
And then to your Spell Class...

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: My stolen ingredients still haven't been recovered--

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Which ingredients again?

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: The ones for the Faunafurreus Elixir! The spell that drives animals into a bloodthirsty rampage!
Then to Cromwell's office as Priam accused you...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: And what about the other thefts?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: The missing keys to the Bestiary, the potions gone missing from the alchemy lab...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: All the thefts occurred `after` you arrived.
nodes.text_bbcode: All the thefts occurred [color=#e23b3b][i]after[/i][/color] you arrived.

nodes.text: And then your mind returns to the present, to where you and Arinna crouch to avoid being seen...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Not after I arrived. After `you` did...
nodes.text_bbcode: Not after I arrived. After [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] did...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: We're roommates because I got here right after you did!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I don't think the animals escaping was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I think someone stole the keys to the Bestiary, so that they would be able to release all the creatures housed there...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And then they stole the Mo'Anna diadem for the scent, to make sure that the gryphon could track you down...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But before they did, they drove it mad with a `Faunafurreus Elixir` to make sure it would finish the job when it found you!
nodes.text_bbcode: But before they did, they drove it mad with a [color=#3b78e2][i]Faunafurreus Elixir[/i][/color] to make sure it would finish the job when it found you!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Somebody wants you out of the picture...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Somebody wants you out of the picture...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You mean this carnage has all been a ploy? A part of some assassination plot?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but it sure looks that way...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: My brother and I came to this school seeking refuge from the war that now ravages our homeland...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It seems the war has followed us here.
Arinna bows her head wearily.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, you can't think about that right now. That gryphon has your scent, and the Faunafurreus Elixir has driven it crazy. It's not going to stop coming after you... `Ever!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Arinna, you can't think about that right now. That gryphon has your scent, and the Faunafurreus Elixir has driven it crazy. It's not going to stop coming after you... [color=#3b78e2][i]Ever![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Arinna looks back up, face hardened into a determined grimace.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Then I must `make` it stop.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I must [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] it stop.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: If I can separate the beast from the `scent` it follows, I may be able to disorient it...
nodes.text_bbcode: If I can separate the beast from the [color=#3b78e2][i]scent[/i][/color] it follows, I may be able to disorient it...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That could give me a chance to fight back!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...You? Don't you mean `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...You? Don't you mean [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: This is not your fight, $CADY. You're not even certain about remaining at this school...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I cannot ask you to risk your life.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That's fine, because I'm `telling you` I've made up my mind... About everything.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's fine, because I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]telling you[/i][/color] I've made up my mind... About everything.

nodes.text: You point toward the gryphon.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: The bundle is tied on with ropes. What if I could cast a spell to knock it free...?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That could work, but you'll need a distraction...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And you must use a more powerful spell than you would've learned in your beginners' class...
You fumble the words, and nothing happens!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Now repeat after me... `Duo... Dupli... Care!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now repeat after me... [color=#e23b3b][i]Duo... Dupli... Care![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Arinna raises her hand, whispers, and a doppelganger appears. It races off across the lawn!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Then we must create a distraction. Quickly, duplicate yourself!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...What?

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKREEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKREEE!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So not good... `RUN!`
nodes.text_bbcode: So not good... [color=#3b78e2][i]RUN![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You and Arinna sprint down the central aisle, heading for the double doors that lead outside!
The gryphon dive bombs, coming right at you!
Arinna reaches the doors first, throwing them open. Instead of following her out, you turn to face the gryphon and raise your hands to launch a spell--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Frigo... Glaci... Alis!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Frigo... Glaci... Alis![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Snow bursts forth in an icy flurry!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ignis... Confla... Gratus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ignis... Confla... Gratus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Fire bursts forth in a singeing wave!
The gryphon plows through the spell face first... And then veers off blindly, crashing through a wooden table.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I did it!
The gryphon screeches and lumbers unsteadily to its feet!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sort of...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Congratulations... `Now come on!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Congratulations... [color=#3b78e2][i]Now come on![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You follow Arinna out the double doors and emerge on one side of the school's great lawn...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh no... Up ahead is all grass. There's no place to hide...
You grab a small, leather-bound text from the shelf beside you and chuck it across the length of the library!
It strikes a shelf on the far wall, knocking scrolls to the floor with a clatter!

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: Hrn...?
The gryphon turns and bounds off, taking to the air...

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKREEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKREEE!!![/i]

nodes.text: And from the higher vantage, immediately spies you and Arinna trying to sneak away...
You leap up and shove, toppling the bookshelf onto the gryphon!

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: Hrn...?
The gryphon is buried beneath an avalanche of dusty, leather-bound spell books that spill down off the heavy, hardwood frame! An opaque cloud of dust swirls up, obscuring view!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Koff... Koff... There seems to be a problem within the custodial department.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Save it for the Suggestion Box. Right now, let's get out of here before that thing...
The mountain of books lurches! The gryphon bursts skyward and circles back around...
You hesitate!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Do something!
Panicked, you reach down and snatch a small, leather-bound text from the shelf beside you and chuck it across the length of the library...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Uh oh...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Uh oh...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: At the last second, a massive force blast strikes it from the side! The gryphon squawks and sprawls to the floor...

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKKSSS!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKKSSS!!![/i]

nodes.text: Priam runs up, eyes steeled for battle.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: `You...` This is your doing. Step away from my sister!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You...[/i][/color] This is your doing. Step away from my sister!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Seriously? Is now really the time?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Brother, $CADY has been with me the entire evening. There's no way this madness is her doing.
Priam stiffens, eyeing the carnage gravely. He looks back to you.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: You claim yourself a friend to my sister...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, we're like total BFFs.
Priam and Arinna stare at you blankly.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Yes... That means yes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes... That means yes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Then take my sister and flee from here. I'll cover your escape.
The gryphon finds its feet, charges Priam, and tackles him to the floor. It drives its beak deep into the meat of his shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: `AAAHH!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AAAHH!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: `...PRIAM!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...PRIAM![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Arinna... `Nnh...` I told you to go!
nodes.text_bbcode: Arinna... [color=#e23b3b][i]Nnh...[/i][/color] I told you to go!

nodes.text: The gryphon grips Priam's limp body in one massive claw and then hurls him across the room!
Priam hits the far wall with a sickening thud, drops, and goes still.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NO!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The gryphon turns back to you and Arinna, shrieking, its beak now stained the deep red hue of shimmering rubies...

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKREEEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKREEEE!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You heard your brother. We have to go... `NOW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You heard your brother. We have to go... [color=#3b78e2][i]NOW![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You grab Arinna by the shoulders and pull her out a small side door.
Elsewhere on campus...
Muffled screams and sounds of panic rouse a tiny, winged creature from where it lies curled up on the floor, drawing it to the closed window.

nodes.speaker: Nameoffamiliar
nodes.text: Hrm?
Outside, terrified students run by in a mob!

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: `...Help! Help us...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...Help! Help us...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: `...It's after us...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]...It's after us...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $NAMEOFFAMILIAR takes to the air, makes a loop, and bashes into the window glass with a thud. Cracks form at the point of impact!

nodes.speaker: Nameoffamiliar
nodes.text: `NRRR....`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NRRR....[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $NAMEOFFAMILIAR shakes off the stun, and then takes to the air and flies at the glass again!
Together, you and Arinna travel down a small passageway and emerge in the school library...
There, you both take shelter behind a tall bookshelf.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: This makes no sense. Why is the gryphon attacking us?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: To be honest, this isn't exactly the first time...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I heard of your previous encounter, but that time, you ventured into its territory...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Maybe it just doesn't like me?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: No, there's some other reason for this. We have to--

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: `SHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]SHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Arinna places her finger to her lips. In the silence, the sound of claws tapping against stone floor can be heard...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...It's here.
Peering through the bookshelves, you and Arinna watch the gryphon slowly lope into the adjacent aisle.
It cocks its head, angling its ear toward you!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: This way!
You grab Arinna by the hand and lead her to the exit, joining the tail end of the mob of students all trying to push their way out.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]RUN!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]RUN!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: The safest thing to do is to get out of here as quickly as possible!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, but until we do, aren't we standing in the open?
From behind comes an avian shriek!

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKREEEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKREEEE!!![/i]

nodes.text: The gryphon rises from the floor, shakes clumps of party mix from its mane, and kicks aside a punch bowl...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, not good. But not bad either...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It's not like that gryphon was specifically coming after us or anythi--
The gryphon whips its head toward you!
It bats aside several nearby students to clear a path and then charges directly toward you and Arinna!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: This way!
You grab Arinna by the hand and lead her to the stage. Together, you both take cover beneath...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: We can hide under here until everything quiets down.
The gryphon rises from the floor, shakes party mix from its mane, and kicks aside a punch bowl...

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKKKK...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKKKK...[/i]

nodes.text: A student runs by, and the gryphon bats him aside, its eyes scouring the darkness...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It's like it's looking for something...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Not something... `Us!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not something... [color=#3b78e2][i]Us![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The gryphon locks eyes with you! It leaps to the air, divebombs down, and drives its razor-sharp talons into the stage.
There is a screech of shredding wood, and then the stage is catapulted skyward! It smashes apart against the far wall!
The gryphon circles overhead and then ferociously swoops down at you!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Uh, I think we should go...?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY, make up your mind!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: This way!
Luke and Simon charge off, fighting through the tide of fleeing students.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: My gods...
Arinna is frozen in place, gazing upon the carnage, wide-eyed. You take her by the hand.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, we both need to get someplace safe--
There is a sharp crash! Glass rain downs!
And when you look up, a winged beast thunders down onto the dance floor directly in front of you both.
It's the `gryphon.` It beats its massive wings and gnashes its beak.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's the [b]gryphon.[/b] It beats its massive wings and gnashes its beak.

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKREEEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKREEEE!!![/i]

nodes.text: The gryphon lunges forward, jaws snapping!
You and Arinna duck, and the gryphon overshoots the mark, sprawling headlong into the refreshment table!

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `RRRNNN!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]RRRNNN!!![/i]

nodes.text: You quickly scan the room. Behind you is an exit door mobbed with students all trying to force their way out simultaneously...
Directly ahead is the elevated stage and a cozy hiding spot beneath.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: What do we do?
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Just promise me you won't do anything stupid, okay?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I'll try to come back in one piece.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Girls can help too!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Yes, they can. Absolutely. Especially when they know more than a few beginner level spells.
Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, right...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Until you do, I need you to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, it's just that, um... Uh...?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: $CADY, there's no time! Get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: At least, someone here gets to have a good time...
Onstage, the demonstration ends. Spellmaster Ang and Luke bow to the crowd, and then they both disappear backstage.
A moment later, Luke returns through a side door. He rushes over to you.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: $CADY, you made it! After everything that happened, I was afraid you weren't coming.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I wasn't sure I had any reason to show...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I understand if you're mad, or if you don't want to talk to me--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No, I do-- I just--

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hey. I get it.
Luke bows slightly and extends his hand to you, palm up. He nods over toward the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Come with me.

You take Luke's hand, and he whisks you onto the floor. He spins you, pulls you tight to his chest, and at once you're both spinning impossibly fast, weightless, suspended in mid-air inches off the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So somebody's taken a few dancing lessons.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: A few. You probably shouldn't look down.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Seriously. You might get dizzy.
You press your cheek against Luke's shoulder and your body to his, feeling his heat and the strength of his arms. And then the song ends...
You drift slowly back to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: I know, pretty boring, right? Been there, done that...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Actually, I was going to say that it was--

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: `LUKE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]LUKE!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Minka storms over and slaps Luke hard across the cheek! Nearby partygoers stop dancing and step away.

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: `You selfish son of a--`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You selfish son of a--[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Minka slaps him again and charges out of the Great Hall. Meredith and a few other girls race after her.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: So that just happened...
Outside...
Husky, snarling bodies stomp and slither up the hill, moving toward the thumping bass and murmuring commotion of the Winter Dance...
The doors crash open, and Minka and Meredith storm out!

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: It's okay, Minka. I'm sure Luke'll come around!

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: He'll come around? Who are you? `My mother?`
nodes.text_bbcode: He'll come around? Who are you? [color=#3b78e2][i]My mother?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Luke made his choice, and now, I'm going to make sure that he suffers for it. Just as soon as I--

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: ...What? Just as soon as you `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...What? Just as soon as you [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Minka is frozen still, lips quivering, eyes locked on a spot several inches above Meredith's head. Meredith turns to look and...
A thick, slimy dollop of pungent drool plops down from above, striking her square in the face!

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: `Blecchhh...` What just got in my mouth?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Blecchhh...[/i][/color] What just got in my mouth?

nodes.text: From above Meredith comes the same low, cooing growl. A creature steps out from the shadows.
Back inside...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Luke, it's okay. I get it. You didn't ask her. She just assumed you would.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Yeah, but...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Luke, you told me life is precious. Why are we wasting it?

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: You're right. Well, technically, `I'm` right...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right. Well, technically, [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] right...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hey!
Luke leans in to kiss you. Then all of a sudden, his lips are pressed tightly against yours and...
Everything melts away.
Simon staggers back over to you and Luke and does a double-take!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Were you two just-- Forget it! It doesn't matter! You have to stop her!
Luke steps away, clearing his throat...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: ...Stop who?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Who do you think? Arinna! I don't know where she learned the phrase 'cut a rug', but she did, and she's dangerous!
Arinna steps over, brandishing a dagger and beaming brightly.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I must admit, this human dancing is enjoyable, even though my partner did prove something of a pacificist.
There is a shriek from across the ballroom, and then a wave of panicked students bolt in all directions!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY... What is this madness? Is this the disco that everyone fears?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I don't think so...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: What-- What's happening...?
In the heart of the chaos, several students turn and lob fireballs in the direction from which they ran. The fire illuminates the shadows and reveals several gnashing beasts within!

nodes.speaker: Hydra
nodes.text: `SSSSSSSS!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SSSSSSSS!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Cerberus
nodes.text: `RRRRRRR!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]RRRRRRR!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Boar
nodes.text: `SNNNRRTT!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SNNNRRTT!!![/i]

nodes.text: Beastmaster Kimuko stumbles in through a door near you. She is bruised, and her hand is pressed tightly to a seeping wound in her abdomen.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: The beasts from the Bestiary... Somebody's set them all loose...
Luke lets go of your hand and turns toward the unfolding chaos...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: $CADY, Simon and I are going to see what we can do to help. You take Arinna and find somewhere safe to hide.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Luke, if this is...
Arinna looks puzzled. She turns back to Simon.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I see. Is this true?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, kinda... I mean, yeah. It is. I even brought you flowers. Among our people, it's a gesture of honorable intentions.
Simon unlocks his elbow and presents the flowers to Arinna.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: To show your affection, you have slaughtered one dozen beautiful flowers?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: That's one way to phrase it...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Among my people, a princess may only be wooed by the Wildefolke who presents the still-beating hearts of seven Deathless Drakes.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh... Okay...
Simon starts to turn away. You grab him by the hand and yank him back.
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But in the meantime, would it hurt to have one dance?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I suppose not. Dance with me, Simon Flower-Slayer. You shall teach me what should first be broken when one break dances.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Okay! That's not exactly what 'break dance' means but--
Arinna yanks Simon onto the dance floor, and begins to grind up against him. He flashes you a thumbs up.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...I am?
You jam down on Simon's foot with one of your high heels. His arm unlocks, and he holds the flowers out.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: `Ow!` I mean, `yeah,` I totally am!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color] I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]yeah,[/i][/color] I totally am!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: But even so, I brought these for you!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: ...Why?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: In our world, it's considered romantic.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: So then, when you decided to slay these flowers and bring them to me, you knew it would cause personal harm?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: ...Yes?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Among my people, a princess may only be wooed by the Wildefolke who presents the still-beating hearts of seven Deathless Drakes.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: `But` this is a different world...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]But[/i][/color] this is a different world...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Come! Dance with me, Simon Flower-Slayer. You shall teach me what should first be broken when one break dances.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Okay! That's not exactly what 'break dance' means but-- `Hyukk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay! That's not exactly what 'break dance' means but-- [color=#e23b3b][i]Hyukk![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Arinna yanks Simon onto the dance floor, and begins to grind up against his leg. He flashes you a thumbs up.
Chaos Up!
Twenty minutes later...
You and Arinna step through the doors of the Great Hall and enter the lavish celebration of Hecate...
Strings of Christmas tree lights float overhead, dance music blares from floating woofers and tweeters, and in the center of the room, students grind on the dance floor together!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Wow, this... This is amazing...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Indeed. It rivals even the Hallowed Day of the Headless T'shank.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Should I ask?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Perhaps not. I've noticed you grow squeamish when I mention tapeworms.
A few heads turn your way and glare. On stage, Luke and Spellmaster Ang cast fireworks spells back and forth, sending blasts of brilliant, multi-colored sparks showering in all directions!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `Dyna... Sanda... Meetay!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Dyna... Sanda... Meetay![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Excellent form, but now try this!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: `Dyna... Sanda... Meetay-TAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Dyna... Sanda... Meetay-TAH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang unleashes a burst of shimmery sparks that explode with the sound of cannon fire!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Your boyfriend is a most impressive magician.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I already told you. He's not my boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And he's not even `here` with me. I heard rumors around school that he invited Minka instead.
nodes.text_bbcode: And he's not even [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color] with me. I heard rumors around school that he invited Minka instead.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: If so, then I'd say their date has gone poorly...
Arinna indicates a small cluster of well-dressed girls on the opposite side of the auditorium.

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: How could he do that to me? He said he didn't even ask me!

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: Well, did he?

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: He asked if I was going... It was totally implied!
Your eyes drift back to the stage, to Luke...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `Dyna... Sanda... Meetay-TAH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Dyna... Sanda... Meetay-TAH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Huh...
Meanwhile, down the hill at the school Bestiary...
The locked gate has been left ajar. Inside, the pens are empty, and the animals are nowhere to be found...
Along the stable floor, tracks lead out and up the hill...
Beastmaster Kimuko steps in through the ajar door, eyes wide with shock!

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: What's happened here?

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: They're out! All the animals have been set free! I need to sound the al--
A low, cooing growl cuts her off mid-sentence. She turns around to confront an enormous, hulking silhouette. It charges her!

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: `FUL... MINI--

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: `SKRREEEEEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKRREEEEEE!!![/i]

nodes.text: Back inside, Simon tentatively steps over from the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh hey, $CADY! I didn't expect to see you here. About what I said yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I was totally, er...
Simon glances back to a cluster of guys standing near the refreshment table. They glare in your direction.

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: He's totally talking to her...

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: He's gone crazy too...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is that I got freaked out, and I did the wrong thing. I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, you're dumb...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But at least you fessed up to it.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Cool... And Princess Arinna, I actually brought something special for, uh... You...
Simon awkwardly attempts to bring a bouquet of flowers out from behind his back. His arm locks up! He can't move...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Labored speech patterns. Rapid heartbeat. Sweating along the brow. All symptoms of illness...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon of the Carylyles, are you sure you should be at a formal gathering in your condition?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Actually, I'm not sick. I'm just, uh...
Simon looks to you, eyes like a deer in headlights... `Help!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Simon looks to you, eyes like a deer in headlights... [b]Help![/b]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Princess Arinna, what Simon means to say is that he is...
You glance over to the bare hangers in the closet...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I don't really have anything to wear. My foster families weren't exactly big on ball gowns.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I thought you might say as much.
Arinna steps out into the hallway and returns bearing a glowing, shimmery gown.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That's... That's for me to wear?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I hope that it's acceptable. Though I trust you, I didn't think Priam would react kindly to me letting you rifle through my closets.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No, it's-- Gorgeous. Arinna...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Please, it is the least I can do.
Arinna steps forward and hands you the gown.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Now put it on. We shouldn't miss the opening ceremonies!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Your paramour Luke is participating in the spellcasting demonstration, and his performance is said to be nothing less than inspired.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Cool, but Luke's not my--
Arinna steps out and closes the door. Out in the living area, you can hear her call to you.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Hurry up! The hour grows late!

You slip into the gown and inspect yourself in your full-length mirror. The cut is slimming at the waist, and the gold threads sewn into the fabric make your skin glow. The exotic beading at the collar gleams like diamonds.
You look elegant, you think, grown up. And more than that, you look `desirable...`
nodes.text_bbcode: You look elegant, you think, grown up. And more than that, you look [b]desirable...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I guess the dress `is` pretty...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess the dress [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] pretty...

nodes.text: $NAMEOFFAMILIAR sits up on the bed excitedly!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That good, huh?
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR flops over onto her back for a belly rub...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hee... I guess now I really do have to go to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: He still hates me, and I don't want to get you in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I appreciate your compassion, $CADY, but dealing with my brother's rash actions is a responsibility that I've grown accustomed to.
Order Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I bet.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Did I ever tell you of the time a Bloodleech attached itself to Priam's hindquarters?  Priam threatened to drain the whole of the Stygian Mire!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sounds bad...?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: A dozen villages would've been without water for their fields. By which I mean to say...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: My brother is brave and proud, but not always `right...`
nodes.text_bbcode: My brother is brave and proud, but not always [color=#3b78e2][i]right...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: If I want to make lightly flirtatious banter with equally well-dressed gentlemen, I will!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Now, are you going to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Did you steal the Mo'anna diadem or anything else from me?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No, but some people think that...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I am not `some` people, $CADY. I am Princess Arinna K'Tarra of the Wilde. Some people may do as they like, but it is my obligation to do what is just.
nodes.text_bbcode: I am not [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] people, $CADY. I am Princess Arinna K'Tarra of the Wilde. Some people may do as they like, but it is my obligation to do what is just.

nodes.text: Chaos Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, and in this case, what is `just?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, and in this case, what is [color=#3b78e2][i]just?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: In this case, I believe the proper course of action would be for the both of us to dress in our finest clothes. Go to the dance...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And make lightly flirtatious banter with equally well-dressed gentlemen!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Excellent!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: It is? I didn't see anything happen...
You speak, and you hear an echo from right behind you. You turn around and face an exact duplicate of yourself.
Spell learned!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...But that's me!

nodes.speaker: Doppelganger
nodes.text: ...But that's me!
Spellmaster Ang waves a hand through your doppelganger.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: It is an illusion, nothing more. But it should be enough to get you out of trouble.
As Spellmaster Ang speaks, your doppelganger fades away.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Try again. The words are... `Duo... Dupli... Care!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Try again. The words are... [color=#e23b3b][i]Duo... Dupli... Care![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Very well. Let us begin.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Yes, I did. Cromwell may believe your lies, but I know better. You stole the Mo'Anna diadem...
The next morning...
You do your best to continue your routine, but it feels as though the whole of the earth has shifted around you...
You wake and exit your bedroom, entering the eerily silent common area.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, I didn't hear you get up. Are you out here or...?
No answer. You step over to Arinna's room and peek inside.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whoa... All her stuff is gone, and she didn't bother to say goodbye.
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR swoops into the bare room, sniffing around for any remaining traces of Arinna. There are none.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whatever. Not like we needed her anyway.
There is a scuffle behind you. You spin around. Priam stands in the doorway, eyeing you with obvious disdain.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Snooping around for scraps?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I assure you, everything of value has been removed, as has my overly trusting sister...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You didn't have to do that...

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: It's only a matter of time before you're found out.
You go to classes...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Frigo... Glaci... Alis!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Frigo... Glaci... Alis![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: You seemed distracted when you cast that `Ice Blast.` Why don't you try `Fire Render?`
nodes.text_bbcode: You seemed distracted when you cast that [color=#e23b3b][i]Ice Blast.[/i][/color] Why don't you try [color=#e23b3b][i]Fire Render?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Ignis... Confla... Gratus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ignis... Confla... Gratus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Hmm, not much of an improvement...
You try to hang out with Simon...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh hey, $CADY, how's it, er... Going? Did you want to talk to me about something?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Simon, why are you whispering?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Because, er... This is a library, and we're supposed to whisper?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Or maybe because you don't want anybody to see you talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No! What would give you that idea? Gotta go! Don't try to follow me!
It seems the distrust incited at the party continues to hang like a pall over the whole school, even muting the otherwise jovial preparations for the Winter Dance...

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: You saw her survive that fall. She's definitely hiding something. Hand me those silver streamers?

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: Sure... `Volo Levi Tatus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure... [color=#e23b3b][i]Volo Levi Tatus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Plus, I heard Cromwell didn't even punish her...
But most devastating of all is the absence of Luke...

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: He got selected to demonstrate advanced spellcasting techniques at the Winter Dance tomorrow, so he's gone into seclusion to practice his spells...

nodes.speaker: Meredith
nodes.text: But at least he asked you to go with him to the Hecate first, right?

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah! Totally...
Finally, the next morning...

You slouch into your spellcasting lesson fifteen minutes late and dump your shoulder bag into the corner. Spellmaster Ang and Headmaster Cromwell stand together at the center of the room, eyeing you with a mixture of irritation and concern.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: $CADY, are you aware of what day it is?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Let me guess. I bet this is the day I practice the same two dumb spells over and over again. You know, like `every` day.
nodes.text_bbcode: Let me guess. I bet this is the day I practice the same two dumb spells over and over again. You know, like [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] day.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: On the contrary, this day is `not` like any other day. Tonight is the Winter Dance, the Hecate. It is a festival of magic and the crossroads.
nodes.text_bbcode: On the contrary, this day is [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] like any other day. Tonight is the Winter Dance, the Hecate. It is a festival of magic and the crossroads.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: While the sun reigns overhead, magicians assume an intellectual challenge. Then when the sun sinks below the horizon, we celebrate with a lavish festival of dancing and wizardry. `Order` then `Chaos...`
nodes.text_bbcode: While the sun reigns overhead, magicians assume an intellectual challenge. Then when the sun sinks below the horizon, we celebrate with a lavish festival of dancing and wizardry. [color=#3b78e2][i]Order[/i][/color] then [color=#3b78e2][i]Chaos...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: On this day, students of age choose their alignment.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, fine... Flip a coin. Done.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I said, students `'of age'.` You are not yet...
nodes.text_bbcode: I said, students [color=#3b78e2][i]'of age'.[/i][/color] You are not yet...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Even so, of all the students at this school, `you` are the one standing at a crossroads.
nodes.text_bbcode: Even so, of all the students at this school, [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] are the one standing at a crossroads.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: The Council has heard rumors of your flippant behavior, and they are troubled. Tardiness, proscribed amusements, accusations of theft...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Adults getting mad at me. So far, nothing new.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: This is serious, $CADY. There are few things more dangerous in this world than an undisciplined spellcaster, especially one possessing your unique gift.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You will now be taught an advanced spell in the alignment of your choosing...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: You must `prove yourself` by mastering it.
nodes.text_bbcode: You must [color=#3b78e2][i]prove yourself[/i][/color] by mastering it.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And if I `don't?`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if I [color=#3b78e2][i]don't?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Then the choice of whether or not you will remain in this school will no longer be yours...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: And possibly no longer mine.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So no pressure...
Cromwell nods to Spellmaster Ang. He steps forward, clears his throat, and extends his palms. In one hand is a ball of ice, and in the other a ball of fire.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: So far, you've learned `Ice Blast` and `Fire Render.` One spell of `Order` and one spell of `Chaos...`
nodes.text_bbcode: So far, you've learned [color=#e23b3b][i]Ice Blast[/i][/color] and [color=#e23b3b][i]Fire Render.[/i][/color] One spell of [color=#e23b3b][i]Order[/i][/color] and one spell of [color=#e23b3b][i]Chaos...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He closes his hands, extinguishing the two spells.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: You must now decide which path you will further.
Spellmaster Ang winks out of view. His voice echoes from where he was standing only moments before...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: If you choose to continue your studies of Order, you will be taught `Cloak of the Unseen...`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you choose to continue your studies of Order, you will be taught [color=#e23b3b][i]Cloak of the Unseen...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang reappears, but in duplicate...

nodes.speaker: Doppelganger
nodes.text: If you choose to continue your studies of Chaos...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: ...You will be taught `Deceitful Double...`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...You will be taught [color=#e23b3b][i]Deceitful Double...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The doppelganger vanishes. Spellmaster Ang now stands where he'd been before, seeming to have never moved at all...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Which do you choose?
The bell rings. You and Simon gather up your equipment and return it to Beastmaster Kimuko where she stands by the Bestiary.
From inside, there is the sound of sniffing and then a rustling sound as something large pivots around inside its pen. A beak jams through the barred window overhead!

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKRRRREEEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKRRRREEEE!!![/i]

nodes.text: The screech catches you off guard! Beastmaster Kimuko notices your wary step backward.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Easy there, $CADY. Hermes isn't going anywhere fast. Those bars are enchanted `still-steel...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Easy there, $CADY. Hermes isn't going anywhere fast. Those bars are enchanted [color=#3b78e2][i]still-steel...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: But he does seem to remember your scent. Could be you're special.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Or maybe you're especially stinky!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yes, Simon, because that's exactly how you talk to girls...

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Anyway, it's like I always say, gryphons are bloodhounds with beaks. They get an object to scent from, and they can track anybody anywhere.
The beak snorts and withdraws.

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SNRRKK!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SNRRKK!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Good to know... I guess.
You and Simon step away, meandering back toward the main building.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh $CADY, I almost forgot. The Hecate is coming up.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hecate?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's what we call the Winter Dance--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You are `not` about to ask me to the--
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] about to ask me to the--

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No no no... Me, Luke, and some of the other guys in the Rebelban residence hall always throw a pre-party a few nights before the dance. You should totally come!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, sounds promising. Why do I get the feeling there's something else?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Well, uh... I was also hoping that you might bring--
Arinna storms over, her hands curled into fists. As she reaches you, she glares back at Meredith furiously.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Per the wishes of Headmaster Cromwell, I have interacted with the human student I have partnered with. I find her disposition... Unpleasant.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah well, we all kind of do...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And yet she has not been executed. Curious...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Did I hear speaking of a celebration?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, er-- `Errr...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, yeah, er-- [color=#e23b3b][i]Errr...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah. Simon's throwing a party, and he thinks that you and I should both go.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Hmm, I doubt Priam would approve, but it `would` further my investigation into human culture...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm, I doubt Priam would approve, but it [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] further my investigation into human culture...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I accept. Simon, when should I expect the carriage to arrive?
The bell rings, signaling the end of class. Meredith storms off, leaving you to gather up your equipment and return it to Beastmaster Kimuko over by the Bestiary.
From inside, there is the sound of sniffing and then a rustling sound as something large pivots around inside its pen. A beak jams through the barred window overhead!

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKRRRREEEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKRRRREEEE!!![/i]

nodes.text: The screech catches you off guard! Beastmaster Kimuko notices your wary step backward.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Easy there, $CADY. Hermes isn't going anywhere fast. Those bars are enchanted `still-steel...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Easy there, $CADY. Hermes isn't going anywhere fast. Those bars are enchanted [color=#3b78e2][i]still-steel...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: But he does seem to remember your scent. Could be you're special.

nodes.speaker: Beastmaster Kimuko
nodes.text: Anyway, it's like I always say, gryphons are bloodhounds with beaks. They get an object to scent from, and they can track anybody anywhere.
The beak snorts and withdraws.

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SNRRKK!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SNRRKK!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Good to know... I guess.
You step away, meandering back toward the main building. A few minutes later, Simon and Arinna join you, talking and laughing...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY, you must hear this! Simon has agreed to help with my instruction in the ways of humanity...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: This oughtta be good. How so?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: The Hecate is coming up in a few days...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hecate?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: It's what we call the Winter Dance--

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: And you and Arinna are--

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: No no no... Me, Luke, and some of the other guys in the Rebelban residence hall always throw a pre-party a few nights before the dance. I've invited Arinna to come.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: So like on a da--

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: --Definitely not a date! Just a couple of crazy guys throwing a party, which girls are also invited to! Including you, $CADY.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Way to man up there, Simon.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Speaking of manservants, when should we expect the carriage to arrive?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Er... `Carriage?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... [color=#e23b3b][i]Carriage?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Calm down, or you're going to burst a blood vessel. Arinna, we'll `walk` over... Together...
nodes.text_bbcode: Calm down, or you're going to burst a blood vessel. Arinna, we'll [color=#3b78e2][i]walk[/i][/color] over... Together...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: So it shall be!

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Hey, are we going to play or what?

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: There's still time to give up!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Not a chance.
Luke gives you a reassuring nod. He picks up a new ping-pong ball, bounces it on his paddle, and then serves it across the table. As it flies through the air, Luke cries out magic words--

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: `Non... Libum... Portalus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Non... Libum... Portalus![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The ping-pong ball zips through a small orange portal that appears over the table and then streaks out of a second blue portal, careening at the red plastic goblet from an entirely new direction!

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Huh...?
At the last second, Brian summons a tiny whirlwind to catch the ball right over the goblet, and Pietro blasts it back over to your side with lightning. Luke paddles the ball back--
The ball continues to fly back and forth across the table, reaching dizzying speeds... Until Luke manages to knock Brian and Pietro off-balance with a massive thunder clap!

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: `WUHH?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WUHH?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: `WHOAA!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WHOAA!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The ping-pong ball flies toward your side of the table, heading right for your cup!

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: $CADY... `NOW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: $CADY... [color=#e23b3b][i]NOW![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: `WHAT?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]WHAT?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]NO!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Nothing but net, losers!
The crowd around the ping-pong table cheers! Luke turns to you.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Nice shot, $CADY! Looks like we make a good team!
Spell learned!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess we `do...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I guess we [color=#3b78e2][i]do...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You stumble on the words...
And in your moment of hesitation, the ping-pong ball plops down into your cup. The crowd erupts in cheers, and Brian and Pietro high five!

nodes.speaker: Brian
nodes.text: Yes! We did it! We totally won!

nodes.speaker: Pietro
nodes.text: We're the new kings of Spell Pong!
Luke turns to you, disappointed...

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Hey, it's okay. It was your first time. You did your best.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's a dumb game anyway.
Game over, the crowd begins to disperse... When a commotion causes every head to turn and look!

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: `OUT OF THE WAY! MOVE!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]OUT OF THE WAY! MOVE![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Priam charges in, shoving partygoers out of his way. Arinna has Priam by his arm, trying to hold him back. Minka follows after them both, gloating.

nodes.speaker: Minka
nodes.text: There she is, Priam! I told you $CADY was hiding in here like a coward!
Priam points a claw-tipped finger in your direction.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: `You...` You were the one who brought my sister to this party!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You...[/i][/color] You were the one who brought my sister to this party!

options.label: And so what if I am?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Excellent work, $CADY. You've demonstrated discipline...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: I only hope it will be enough to persuade the Council to allow you to remain at SpellClaive...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: But enough of that, you have the Winter Dance to get ready for!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, about that. I'm probably skipping it...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Skipping the Hecate? But that's simply not done!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Everyone goes: students, teachers, even our guests from the Wilde!

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Professor Ang.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Apologies, Headmaster...

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: $CADY, if you skip the Winter Dance, you'll have plenty of time to practice your spells, but even so, I would strongly encourage you to go. It's always wisest to face your problems directly. Think about it.

Cromwell steps out, and you collect your bag. As you move to exit, Potionsmaster Buttwerst forces his way inside the room and knocks you back in. He is sweaty, like he's been running about in a panic.

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: Spellmaster, could I have a moment?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Apparently, you can...

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: Thank you. You see, my stolen ingredients still haven't been recovered--

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Which ingredients again?

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: The ones for the Faunafurreus Elixir! The spell that drives animals into a bloodthirsty rampage!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Yes, I remember now. But that doesn't explain why you're in my office now...

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: Because the Hecate is tonight, and I just remembered that Buggleroot is also an ingredient in my world-famous Open Sesame Rolls...

nodes.speaker: Potionsmith Buttwerst
nodes.text: Might I borrow some?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: I'd be doing us all a favor if I said 'no'...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: But `sigh...` Come along.
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]sigh...[/i][/color] Come along.

nodes.text: Spellmaster Ang turns toward the cupboards at the back of the classroom. He glances back in your direction...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: And you, what are you still doing here? You heard the headmaster. Class dismissed.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yes, but--

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Go!
Spellmaster Ang ushers you out, and the door slams shut behind you!
Several hours later...
You enter your room. Outside, cheers of happy students can be heard through the open window. You shut it and flop back on your bed.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Face your problems directly... Yeah right.
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR flutters over from where she sleeps on top of a chest of drawers and nestles in next to you.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Well, at least `you` still like me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, at least [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] still like me.

nodes.text: There is a heavy knock on the door. The handle turns, and the door inches open. Arinna peers in...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: $CADY? Are you in?
You leap up...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whoa, yeah... Arinna, you're still talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Of course! Are we not friends?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Sure we are, but... You moved out. I thought that you weren't speaking to me.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Am I not speaking to you now?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, but...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You've learned a defensive spell, have you not? Cast it now!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Oh right!
You search your memory, remembering your class with Spellmaster Ang...
Then shout out the words to the spell...
Just then, the gryphon bursts from the library skylight and scans the area...

nodes.speaker: Gryphon
nodes.text: `SKREEE!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]SKREEE!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: And you remember the words?
Arinna dashes out from behind the crate, waving her arms over her head!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Come and get me!
The gryphon roars and bounds skyward after her. It arcs high and then dive-bombs!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Only going to get one shot at this...
You raise your hands, allowing power to surge through your body and concentrate in your fingertips.
You muddle the words of the spell! Nothing happens! You try to cast the spell again--
But the gryphon is already upon Arinna. It snatches the princess up and swoops into the air, rising higher and higher until it passes in front of the moon.
There, cast in stark silhouette, it releases Arinna. She drops like a stone. There is a distant, haunting scream followed by a sickening thunk.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, I'm sorry... I tried...
You run to where her body lays and collapse to your knees beside her, sobbing, failing to notice that the gryphon has circled back around and is now headed right your direction...
You have failed.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Unfortunately, that's still incorrect...
Spellmaster Ang looks to Cromwell. They share a disappointed frown.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay... So isn't there another way I could learn the spell?

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: I'm afraid not, $CADY. As I said, advanced spells are beyond the purview of my tutorial spells...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, fine... I'll try again tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: Actually, $CADY, it's not that simple. This was a challenge from the Council...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Okay, so... What then? What happens now?

nodes.speaker: Cromwell
nodes.text: It's rare that I admit a student to SpellClaive who lacks the talent and discipline to succeed, but it does happen. I'm sorry, $CADY, this is much more my fault than yours.
Cromwell reaches out and places a hand on your shoulder. You feel a sudden sharp chill and then--
You're enveloped in a strange, shimmering darkness that creeps silently through the crevices of your brain...
When you wake, you're sitting alone in a train station, a bag at your feet.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whu-- Where am I? And while I'm asking questions...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: `Who` am I?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Who[/i][/color] am I?

nodes.text: Business travelers stride by carrying leather briefcases. Loud families amble past with oversized bags perched precariously atop courtesy carts. You stumble nervously to your feet.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Excuse me. Does anybody-- Does anybody know `who I am?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me. Does anybody-- Does anybody know [color=#3b78e2][i]who I am?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: No one cares to answer, and in fact, no one `cares` at all. You slump back down into your seat, consumed by a deep and terrifying dread. To your very bones, you know...
nodes.text_bbcode: No one cares to answer, and in fact, no one [b]cares[/b] at all. You slump back down into your seat, consumed by a deep and terrifying dread. To your very bones, you know...

nodes.text: You follow Arinna out the double doors and emerge on one side of the school's great lawn...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh no... Up ahead is all grass. There's no place to hide...
The next morning...
You do your best to continue your routine, but it feels as though the whole of the earth has shifted around you...
You wake and exit your bedroom, entering the eerily silent common area.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, I didn't hear you get up. Are you out here or...?
No answer. You step over to Arinna's room and peek inside.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whoa... All her stuff is gone, and she didn't bother to say goodbye.
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR swoops into the bare room, sniffing around for any remaining traces of Arinna. There are none.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whatever. Not like we needed her anyway.
There is a scuffle behind you. You spin around. Priam stands in the doorway, eyeing you with obvious disdain.

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: Snooping around for scraps?

nodes.speaker: Priam
nodes.text: I assure you, everything of value has been removed, as has my overly trusting sister...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: You didn't have to do that...

args.text: You sit in a chair in the middle of Cromwell's office. Priam circles you, hurling accusatory comments while Cromwell bristles...
Calm down, Priam, let's discuss this...
What's there to discuss? The thief admits to having access to the Mo'Anna diadem before it went missing...
She is the only possible suspect, and need I remind you, she fled when confronted with her crimes!
She fled a `party`, Priam, where you `attacked` her...
And we found her still on school grounds. For a master criminal, she's done an extremely poor job executing her getaway.
Perhaps she was attempting to conceal her ill-gotten gains along the campus perimeter.
Or perhaps, there's another side to the story. $CADY, is there something you'd like to say to us?
I didn't steal anything!|Priam can sit and spin!
More like how dare `you!` There's no proof that I took anything, but you're acting like I did anyway!
You must admit, the girl is correct, Priam. There's no concrete evidence that she took anything...
No proof? The proof is what `isn't` there! The Mo'Anna diadem!
I don't know who could've done it or why... All I know is that I didn't do it!
You must admit, the girl does sound convincing, Priam. Perhaps you have been overzealous with your accusations?
Of course, she lies convincingly. She's a criminal. That's what criminals do!
And what about the other thefts?
The missing keys to the Bestiary, the potions gone missing from the alchemy lab...
I don't know anything about that!
So you say! But all the thefts occurred `after` you arrived.
So? That doesn't mean I did any of it!
Maybe, maybe not... Tell me. Are you willing to prove your innocence?
Priam steps over to a nearby desk. From it, he retrieves a heavy rectangular object covered by a red cloth.
He whips off the cloth, revealing a large, leather-bound tome with a gold-embossed hand print on the cover. Above the hand print, also in gold, are mystical magic words.
Place your hand on this book, and we'll find out if you're telling the truth or not!
You know the Tome of Mithriel is not to be used on minors, certainly not minors who cannot comprehend the consequences.
Wait... That book will know if I'm lying?
Yes, it will, but it will also inflict tremendous pain on anyone who carries deception in their heart.
Fine! I'm not lying! Let me do this!
No, $CADY, you don't understand. We `all` deceive, every one of us, even if the only person we seek to deceive is ourselves...
Which is precisely why its use is restricted to `adults` who've demonstrated they can withstand the agony.
Cromwell turns to Priam, her voice dropping to a commanding growl.
Put your hand on the book!
Cromwell snaps, and the door to the hall pops open.
Leave us, Priam. I'd ask to speak with my pupil... `Alone.`
You leap from the seat, and wrestle the book away from Priam...
You slam your palm against the handprint!
No, $CADY, you don't know what you're--
A bolt of lightning shoots up your arm, surging through your body! You collapse, twitching in pain! Cromwell kneels beside you.
$CADY, are you all right? That was a very foolish thing you just did...
What are you doing? Ask her where the stolen items are before the spell wears off!
I... I didn't steal that diadem... Or anything else since I've been here...
Cromwell helps you back into your chair, glowering at Priam.
No. There must be some mistake. Or maybe she figured out how to fool the codex somehow...
Cromwell snaps, and the door to the hall pops open.
Leave us, Priam. I'd ask to speak with my pupil... `Alone.`
Cromwell waits for Priam to exit, and then sits down on a chair opposite you. From a nearby tray, she pours a glass of water from a pitcher and offers it to you.
So what? He was Bad Wizard, and now you're Good Wizard?
You take a sip. One last shudder of electricity surges through you and then dissipates.
On the contrary, Priam may not be satisfied, but I believe you to be innocent of the crimes you are accused...
On the contrary, Priam may not be satisfied, but I believe you've demonstrated your innocence...
No matter how ill-advised that demonstration was.
I would like to discuss what happened earlier in the evening, when you fell off the balcony at Rebelban House...
I don't know. I fell, and I landed somewhere else. Then I came back.
And this `somewhere else`, did you recognize it?
No. I mean, it looked different, like another world. Do you know what happened?
You see, $CADY, the great duality of Magic extends not just to spellcasting, but to the very fabric of our universe.
One on side of the coin is our world, the world you are in right now.
On the other... Is the Wilde.
Traveling between the two worlds is extremely difficult, something that can only be accomplished by powerful wizards, and only then, at great cost...
Like with Priam and Arinna, how they got stuck at this school...
Exactly right, child... Priam and Arinna are safe here precisely because it would be nearly impossible to follow after them.
But there are legends of great magicians, `Wildewalkers`, who can travel freely between our world and the Wilde at will.
But this was just a fiction, a fantasy I had no reason to believe... Until I met you.
Yes, I do. I believe that your abilities manifest in times of mortal danger, whisking you to safety and then bringing you back again.
I believe that's what happened tonight, and I believe it's what happened years ago...
Words catch in your throat. Your face flushes, eyes starting to tear...
With time, you may be able to harness this power. You may learn how to move yourself and others at will...
No. You're talking about the car crash...
Why'd you tell me that?|Have you been stalking me?
You're talking about the day my mother and brother died. Just how long have you been watching me?
And you just left me to rot in those crappy foster homes?
You're not being fair. I'm not allowed to interfere in a student's life unless the Council agrees, and they were--
Now I have to live with the knowledge that my mother and brother are dead, and I had the power to save them...
No, $CADY, you didn't know... There was nothing you could've...
I'm here, aren't I? Are you telling me that if I'd known there wasn't some chance, I could've done something to save them...
Screw fair, and screw this whole place. But most of all...
You rise from your seat and storm toward the doorway. Cromwell steps after you...
...Only stopping when the door slams shut in her face!
Cromwell waits for Priam to exit, and then sits down on a chair opposite you. From a nearby tray, she pours a glass of water from a pitcher and offers it to you.
So what? He was Bad Wizard, and now you're Good Wizard?
You take a sip. One last shudder of electricity surges through you and then dissipates.
On the contrary, Priam may not be satisfied, but I believe you to be innocent of the crimes you are accused...
On the contrary, Priam may not be satisfied, but I believe you've demonstrated your innocence...
No matter how ill-advised that demonstration was.
I would like to discuss what happened earlier in the evening, when you fell off the balcony at Rebelban House...
I don't know. I fell, and I landed somewhere else. Then I came back.
And this `somewhere else`, did you recognize it?
No. I mean, it looked different, like another world. Do you know what happened?
You see, $CADY, the great duality of Magic extends not just to spellcasting, but to the very fabric of our universe.
One on side of the coin is our world, the world you are in right now.
On the other... Is the Wilde.
Traveling between the two worlds is extremely difficult, something that can only be accomplished by powerful wizards, and only then, at great cost...
Like with Priam and Arinna, how they got stuck at this school...
Exactly right, child... Priam and Arinna are safe here precisely because it would be nearly impossible to follow after them.
But there are legends of great magicians, `Wildewalkers`, who can travel freely between our world and the Wilde at will.
But this was just a fiction, a fantasy I had no reason to believe... Until I met you.
Yes, I do. I believe that your abilities manifest in times of mortal danger, whisking you to safety and then bringing you back again.
I believe that's what happened tonight, and I believe it's what happened years ago...
Words catch in your throat. Your face flushes, eyes starting to tear...
With time, you may be able to harness this power. You may learn how to move yourself and others at will...
No. You're talking about the car crash...
Why'd you tell me that?|Have you been stalking me?
You're talking about the day my mother and brother died. Just how long have you been watching me?
And you just left me to rot in those crappy foster homes?
You're not being fair. I'm not allowed to interfere in a student's life unless the Council agrees, and they were--
Now I have to live with the knowledge that my mother and brother are dead, and I had the power to save them...
No, $CADY, you didn't know... There was nothing you could've...
I'm here, aren't I? Are you telling me that if I'd known there wasn't some chance, I could've done something to save them...
Screw fair, and screw this whole place. But most of all...
You rise from your seat and storm toward the doorway. Cromwell steps after you...
...Only stopping when the door slams shut in her face!
Priam glowers at you, places the book back on the table, and covers it up...
Now leave us. You have a lesson plan to prepare, and I need to speak with my pupil. Alone.
Put Priam's hand on the book!
Cromwell snaps, and the door to the hall pops open.
Leave us, Priam. I'd ask to speak with my pupil... `Alone.`
You leap from the seat, and wrestle the book away from Priam...
Then you grab Priam's hand and slam it down!
No! $CADY, stop! You don't know what you're--
Priam wrenches back in agony, then collapses, twitching in pain.
$CADY, what do you think you're doing?!
I just wanted to know... Does he really think I stole all that stuff?
But I didn't... I thought that maybe you...
Were trying to frame me or something...
Why would I bother? You've done a fine job at framing yourself.
Cromwell kneels down and helps Priam back up to his feet.
Priam, are you well enough to go?
If you're able, please leave us. I'd like to reprimand my pupil... `Alone.`
You feel your body tense, and words gather on the tip of your tongue!
You raise your hands and summon a powerful blast of flame!
The ground rushes up at you!
In the instant before impact, you close your eyes tightly. You feel a jerk and--
You slam down into something soft...
Looking up, you see drifts of white powder on all sides of you. You've fallen headlong into the pillowy embrace of a snow bank...
I'm-- I'm alive... That fall should've killed me, but...
You dig your way up and out, expecting to see Luke or Arinna beaming down at you from the balcony, pleased by the cleverness of the spell they cast...
But there is no balcony. There is no Rebelban House. You are in the middle of a remote, arctic wilderness, surrounded on all sides by towering, ice-kissed pines...
You spin around quickly. Above you, crouched on a craggy outcrop of rock, is a nightmare from a day you'd tried so desperately to forget...
That smell, so familiar... Could it be? After all this time...
You got away last time, Little Girl. My mistake for toying with my food. I won't make that mistake a second time!
The muscles in the beast's haunches fire like pistons! It rockets down at you from its perch, moving impossibly fast!
There's no time to flee. No time to even turn away. You brace yourself for impact and then--
There's a jolt, like you've been kicked, and when you look back up, you're outside the Rebelban House once again. Fellow students look down at you with eyes wide open and mouths agape.
Priam shoves to the front of the crowd and points down to you!
You see! She claims to be a novice, and yet she survived the fall using magic!
No, I didn't. I don't even know `how` I...
From the students comes a nervous murmur of agreement with Priam. Looks of astonishment turn to looks of distrust, then to looks of outright `fear...`
And then, like you've done when faced with so many other problems in your life...
The blast of flame singes Priam, but he clenches his teeth and holds steady...
He fires a wave of energy your direction! It strikes center mass, and you're knocked back, feeling your body grow stiffer with each new step!
You stumble out onto the balcony, go stiff as a plank... And fall headlong over the railing!
The wave of ice freezes Priam, but he clenches his teeth and holds steady...
Your bolt of lightning singes Priam, but he clenches his teeth and holds steady...
Your vortex of air bats Priam about, but he clenches his teeth and holds steady...
You raise your hands and summon a powerful blast of ice!
