A friendly voice cuts across the vale.
Like you don't know where I am already. I bet you've got a swarm of Magical Finder Squirrels...
Luke waves at you from above at the top of the hill. His familiar flies above him...
Just Cornelius, actually... But he's pretty good.
Great. More proof that I don't know enough to belong here.
Luke soft-pedals down the embankment and takes a seat beside you along the edge of the stream.
Yes, I came here `alone` because I wanted to talk.
Look, I know you, and I `know` you wouldn't do something like this. So why don't we just go back there and clear things up?
No. I'm not going to stand there and explain things to some psycho who threw me out a window.
He can go on thinking I'm some kind of low-life klepto for all I care. I don't need to impress him.
But... You have to stand up for yourself! Otherwise it just looks like he's right!
So you're just making yourself look guilty!
Unless... Maybe that's what you really want?
What are you trying to say?
Maybe you `want` people to be wrong about you...
If people don't care about you, maybe it's easier for you not to care about them.
Like you would know.|You're pretty smart, huh?
Nah, I'm just observant. I can tell when somebody is trying to push people away.
What? No, I mean... A little, but not like that. I mean, unless you wanted me to...
You turn to Luke, cheeks glistening...
That's my point. Guys like you `don't` talk to girls like me. And when they do...
They're just looking to get what they want and then leave afterwards.
Yeah. You're cute. You're smart. You were practically perfect to begin with, and then you found out you could cast magic spells!
I don't think you give yourself enough credit. When I look at you, I don't see what's happened in your life. I see what you could become.
Trust me. I know someone special when I see them...
And I also know what it looks like when somebody I care about is about to slip away...
I didn't lose both my parents like you did, but my little sister got sick. Really sick...
Luke glances down to the pocketwatch in his hands.
I'd just about given up when Minka gave me this. I don't know where she got it, but it made a difference...
Yeah. It's all out of juice now, but when it worked, I was able to use it to spend more time with my sister before the end...
The point is that I get it. Life sucks sometimes. But life doesn't get any better by pushing people away. You need people, and there are people who need you too.
You were practically perfect to begin with, and then you found out you could cast magic spells!
What do you know about how I feel?
You really think you're the only one who's had a tough time?
I mean, I didn't lose both my parents like you did, but my little sister got sick. Really sick...
Luke glances down to the pocketwatch in his hands.
I'd just about given up when Minka gave me this. I don't know where she got it, but it made a difference...
Yeah. It's all out of juice now, but when it worked, I was able to use it to spend more time with my sister before the end...
The point is that I get it. Life sucks sometimes. But life doesn't get any better by pushing people away. You need people, and there are people who need you too.
Luke flicks the stopwatch shut and then pockets it away.
Time spent with people you care about is precious... `Always.`
And the truth is... I care about you.
Luke leans in, breath soft, deep blue eyes locked on yours, close enough for you to feel the warmth of his body radiating off his chest.
Let him kiss you!|Kiss him first!|Push him off you!
You hold perfectly still, air held tight in your chest, and you feel Luke's lips press against your own. Your heart races, your knees wobble.
Luke moves in to kiss you again, when--
You look up the hill to see Priam and Cromwell leading an impromptu search party. Priam points toward you and Luke...
The search party races down the hill, forming a tight circle around you both. Luke rises, stepping between you and Priam.
Hey! Relax! She already told you she didn't do it.
And you believe her? I've heard the rumors surrounding her arrival...
She was a thief from the moment anyone here laid eyes on her.
You step forward, moving around Luke to face Priam directly.
Luke, it's okay. You don't have to defend me.
Grab the girl! Place her in shackles!
The other students begin to step forward, but Cromwell waves them back.
I don't think shackles will be necessary, will they, $CADY?
Very good. Now, if you and Luke have finished your talk, would you be so kind as to join me in my office for a private discussion?
Cromwell turns and starts up the steep hill toward the administration building. You fall in line after her, followed by Priam, and then the rest of the search party.
Until only Luke is left behind, watching you go...
You reach forward, grab Luke by the hair on the back of his head, and yank him into a deep kiss.
You pull Luke forward to kiss him again, when--
Your hands feel their way up Luke's chest, grab him by the collar, and shove him back!
Really? I... I thought we had something...
I'm not saying we don't, but let's not take this step right now, okay?
You and Luke share a long, awkward silence, when--

Your feet pound the long cobblestone path, until at last they bring you to the entrance to SpellClaive Academy. You throw open the iron gate, move to step through, but then a voice from behind stops you...
So that's it? You're leaving? Just like that?
You turn back to see Luke standing further up the cobblestone path.
Don't try to make me stay.
I'm not. I just want to know where you're going.
Away from this stupid place, with all the stupid magic and the stupid people. I don't belong here. I never did. I'm just going to `go`, and after that...
You'll never have to think about me again.
You think that's what I want? I'm your `friend...`
And more than that, I know what's waiting for you outside those walls. Foster care. Boring classes you were always skipping out on anyway. And that's `if` you're lucky...
You just need to ask yourself. Was being here really so bad?

The gate creaks, swaying on its hinges and drawing your attention to the world beyond: fields, forests, and through a veil of mist, the glimmering, pinprick lights of the city. So cold and not at all like... `Home.`
You turn back to face Luke, but the path is now empty.
A shadow flashes by, and you look up. $NAMEOFFAMILIAR swoops down from above and lands at your feet. It drops a Magic Stick and looks up at you expectantly...

You really don't want to give me another reason to leave.

And you head slowly back to your room.

nodes.text_bbcode: Now repeat after me... [color=#e23b3b][i]Duo... Dupli... Care![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Excellent!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...Is it? I didn't `see` anything...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Is it? I didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]see[/i][/color] anything...

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: And neither do I. Look in this mirror.
Spellmaster Ang directs your attention to the mirror on the wall. His reflection is visible... But yours is not!
Spell learned!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I'm... I'm completely invisible!

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Only momentarily... But it should be enough to get you out of trouble.
As Spellmaster Ang speaks, you fade back into view.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Then we must hide ourselves in plain sight. Quickly, conceal yourself!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: ...What?
Arinna raises her hand, whispers, and vanishes right before your eyes.

nodes.speaker: Spellmaster Ang
nodes.text: Now repeat after me... `Clara... Trans... Luceo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now repeat after me... [color=#e23b3b][i]Clara... Trans... Luceo![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The world shimmers, and you feel your entire body disappear!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Nice!
Seeing nothing, it sets down in the middle of the lawn.
Arinna winks into view beside you...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What about `Wind Weave?` I was learning how to cast it right before your big bro tossed me off the balcony at the party.
nodes.text_bbcode: What about [color=#3b78e2][i]Wind Weave?[/i][/color] I was learning how to cast it right before your big bro tossed me off the balcony at the party.

nodes.speaker: Luke
nodes.text: Just concentrate and say the words... `Typhon... Turbi... Nus!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just concentrate and say the words... [color=#e23b3b][i]Typhon... Turbi... Nus![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I think so...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Good.
A powerful gust of air blasts from your fingertips, loop-de-looping toward the gryphon. You fall to your knees, drained...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Come on, come on...
`VOOOSHHH!!`! The blast strikes the beast square in the shoulder!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]VOOOSHHH!![/b]! The blast strikes the beast square in the shoulder!

nodes.text: Startled, the gryphon pivots mid-air, and the tangle of fabric and metal on its shoulder is jostled free from its bindings!

You sit stiffly outside Cromwell's office, fingers toying with the hall pass that summoned you here. You shift in your seat, searching for a more comfortable position. The deep scratches on your back are healing slowly, but they still throb with a dull ache.
